body.name: Exact rational absorbing-face witness
body.construction: Let \(P(D=1)=1/2\), \(\pi_1^d=\pi_2^d=1/2\), and let \(X_0\) be uniform on \(\mathcal A\) conditional on \((Z,D)\). With row and column order \((a,b,e)\), set \(H_1=\begin{psmallmatrix}3/4&1/4&0\\1/4&3/4&0\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(H_2=\begin{psmallmatrix}1/3&2/3&0\\2/3&1/3&0\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(Q_1=\begin{psmallmatrix}3/5&3/10&1/10\\1/5&1/2&3/10\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(Q_2=\begin{psmallmatrix}1/5&2/5&2/5\\3/10&3/5&1/10\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(V_1=\begin{psmallmatrix}7/10&1/5&1/10\\1/5&3/5&1/5\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), and \(V_2=\begin{psmallmatrix}1/5&1/2&3/10\\1/4&1/2&1/4\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\). Use \(H_j\) from date \(0\) to \(1\), \(Q_j\) for untreated transitions from dates \(1\) to \(2\) and \(2\) to \(3\), and \(V_j\) for the treated transition from date \(2\) to \(3\); extend through date \(4\) by the same relevant kernel. This law is \(\omega^\star\).
